title: Woodcuts
lede: Woodcut graphics drawn in code: a black shape, white carved lines and a slightly rough printed edge. Swallows, mountains, leaves, wind, fruit, people in a circle, seeds and sprouts. Every file is an SVG on a transparent ground, and its ink follows the page's text colour.
use_for: Punctuation anywhere: one per section, beside a heading, a quote or a list.
colour_rule: Ink of the ground: ink on light grounds, chalk on night, or one of the three illustration inks. The red seeds are the one red graphic; keep them occasional.
notes: The carved lines are real cut-outs: the ground shows through them, as in a print.
